explanation: Tulip (flower), Oak (tree), Carrot (vegetable), and Wheat (grain) are all members of the Plant Kingdom (Plantae). Mushroom is a member of the Fungi Kingdom.
Fathom, Hand, Rod, and Link are all historical or traditional units used to measure length or distance. Hertz is a modern SI unit of frequency.
All tokens except 'PURPLE' are compound words or phrases that contain the name of a color as a distinct substring, but the word itself is not that color. 'PURPLE' is simply the name of a color.
